title: Divisor quotients of algebraic strict henselizations of prime localizations
statement: Let $R,C$ be commutative rings, $q\subset R$ prime, and $A=R_q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Let $K$ be a field with a separable-closure structure over the residue field of $A$, an $A$-algebra structure compatible with its residue-field algebra structure, and let $C$ be an $A$-algebra which is an algebraic strict henselization of $A$ relative to $K$ [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. Let $b:R\to C$ be a ring homomorphism such that $R\to A\to C$ equals $b$, and let $f\in q$. Then there exist a prime $p\subset R/(f)$, a field $L$ which is a separable closure of the residue field of $B=(R/(f))_p$, compatible residue-field and $B$-algebra structures on $L$, and a $B$-algebra structure on $C/(b(f))$ such that it is an algebraic strict henselization of $B$ relative to $L$.

source.place: Tag 05WS, algebra.tex, lemma-quotient-strict-henselization; localization of quotient as in Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Ideal

proof.text: Set J=(f), p=q/J and I=J R_q. The containment J<=q proves p prime and identifies its contraction with q. The image of the prime-complement submonoid under R->R/J is exactly the complement of p.
Use the quotient localization instance and uniqueness of localization to construct R_q/I isomorphic to (R/J)_p. Its composite with the quotient map is a surjection with kernel I.

Choose L to be the canonical separable closure of the residue field of B=(R/J)_p, and give it the B-action through the residue map. The quotient map C -> C/IC kills ker(pi)=I, so RingHom.liftOfSurjective constructs the B-action on C/IC. Its composition with pi equals the quotient of the A-action by liftOfSurjective_comp_apply. Apply the adopted upstream surjective local-quotient theorem with that compatibility equation. Extension of the principal ideal I is generated by b(f), by hbase; substitute this ideal equality in the dependent existential conclusion and package L and all its structures.

theorem IsStrictHenselization.localized_divisor_quotient
    (R C : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing C]
    (q : Ideal R) [q.IsPrime]
    (K : Type u) [Field K]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime q)) K]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime q)) K]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) K]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime q)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime q)) K]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) C]
    (hC : IsStrictHenselization (Localization.AtPrime q) K C)
    (b : R →+* C)
    (hbase : ∀ r : R, algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime q) C
      (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q) r) = b r)
    (f : R) (hf : f ∈ q) :
    ∃ (p : Ideal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f})) (_ : p.IsPrime)
      (L : Type u) (_ : Field L)
      (_ : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) L)
      (_ : IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) L)
      (_ : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) L)
      (_ : IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime p)
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) L)
      (_ : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (C ⧸ Ideal.span {b f})),
      IsStrictHenselization (Localization.AtPrime p) L
        (C ⧸ Ideal.span {b f})
